events.title: AI-driven data-center growth may stress transformer supply and domestic manufacturing
events.summary: Growth in AI workloads could increase transformer demand, stressing supply chains for copper and specialized manufacturing capacity. What to monitor: procurement lead times and copper availability.

events.title: Offshore wind growth increases near-term demand for HVDC and long-distance corridors
events.summary: Offshore wind expansion may increase pressure on HVDC deployment and cross-border transmission corridors, with permitting and coordination as key chokepoints.

events.title: Export-control signals could affect high-voltage switchgear sourcing and project timelines
events.summary: Export-control policy signals could constrain switchgear sourcing and delay transmission projects; mapping supply-chain concentration is a near-term priority.

events.title: EPC and OEM ramp in India could shorten substation project timelines — with contractor bandwidth caveats
events.summary: India's EPC/OEM scale-up may reduce equipment scarcity but contractor and permitting constraints could still delay completion; early procurement and phased commissioning are practical mitigations.

events.title: Summer peak signals raise case for battery and microgrid resilience at data centers
events.summary: Heat-driven peaks increase short-term grid stress for data centers; batteries and microgrids are practical resilience responses to monitor and deploy.

events.title: Curtailment signals in high-renewable regions highlight need for flexibility and market reforms
events.summary: Rising curtailment in renewables-heavy areas increases the imperative for flexibility solutions and market reforms to fairly value dispatchable services.

events.title: Lithium supply concentration signals could raise battery-manufacturing risk
events.summary: Concentration in lithium supply creates scenario risk for battery manufacturing; diversification and early procurement reduce exposure.

events.title: Capacity-market reform signals change investment calculus for flexibility providers
events.summary: Potential capacity-market reforms could change revenue certainty for flexibility assets; developers should include policy reform scenarios in financial models.

events.title: AI optimization of dispatch improves efficiency but may increase cyber and vendor-concentration risks
events.summary: AI can materially improve grid operations but introduces cyber and concentration risks that require active mitigation and governance.

events.title: Battery storage deployments in Australia may improve frequency regulation but hinge on nickel supply
events.summary: Australian battery projects can capture frequency-regulation value, but nickel feedstock dynamics could affect procurement and timing.
